[[File:Dalan_Oberos_StarViper_GFH.png|thumb|right|250px|Oberos owned both a M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter and a ''StarViper'' Mk. II.]]
'''Dalan Oberos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] in the employ of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Oberos captured and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] early into the Empire's reign, bolstering his reputation, though such marks became rarer over the ensuing [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The hunter was commissioned by the Imperial [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Erron Irbian]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], coming into conflict with a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]s on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="CotG" />

At some point, Oberos worked as a hired gun for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] flying his own [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]] seen departing from an [[Unidentified shadowport|unidentified]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] located in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].<ref name="M12L">{{FFGXW|set=M12-L Kimogila Fighter Expansion Pack|cardname=Dalan Oberos}}</ref> Remorseless and indefatigable, Oberos was unaccepting of failure or defeat and was willing to pursue targets beyond the contract of an employer. He possessed a practiced resistance to Force abilities. Oberos was armed with a custom [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower carbine]] equipped with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-deactivating [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] rounds, [[Cortosis gauntlet/Legends|cortosis gauntlets]], and cortosis-laced [[battle armor]], as well as a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="CotG" /> He also owned a [[StarViper Mk. II|''StarViper'' Mk. II]].<ref name="GFH">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Dalan Oberos}}</ref>
